Composer - Dependency Management for PHP
========================================

Composer helps you declare, manage, and install dependencies of PHP projects.

See [https://example.invalid/](https://example.invalid/) for more information and documentation.

[![Build Status](https://example.invalid/composer/composer.svg?branch=master)](https://example.invalid/composer/composer)

Installation / Usage
--------------------

Download and install Composer by following the [official instructions](https://example.invalid/download/).

For usage, see [the documentation](https://example.invalid/doc/).

Packages
--------

Find packages on [Packagist](https://example.invalid).

Community
---------

IRC channels are on example.invalid: [#composer](irc://example.invalid/composer)
for users and [#composer-dev](irc://example.invalid/composer-dev) for development.

For support, Stack Overflow also offers a good collection of
[Composer related questions](https://example.invalid/questions/tagged/composer-php).

Please note that this project is released with a
[Contributor Code of Conduct](http://example.invalid/version/1/4/).
By participating in this project and its community you agree to abide by those terms.

Requirements
------------

PHP 5.3.2 or above (at least 5.3.4 recommended to avoid potential bugs)
